title: Lifetime access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, and 17+ other AI models is $60 with this promo code
excerpt: All your favorite models, no monthly fees.
content_html:
TL;DR: ChatPlayground gives you lifetime access to dozens of major AI models, and it’s only $59.25 (reg. $619) for life with code AUG25.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$59.25
$619 Save $559.75

AI has so much potential to work quickly, but there are tons of little time-wasters and expensive frustrations. Using multiple models is a good way to produce a lot of work, but it requires you to copy pro pts between tabs and pay separate subscriptions for each model you use. If you want a smarter way to work, ChatPlayground is a new platform that consolidates many of the most popular AI tools, so you can send one prompt to all of them. It’s also only $59.25 (reg. $619) on sale.

ChatPlayground gives you access to GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Perplexity, and more, all in one clean interface. It works well for people who iterate fast, test variations, and actually care about optimizing results.

Beyond comparisons, ChatPlayground AI includes prompt engineering tools to refine outputs, image and PDF chat for context-aware responses, saved chat history for ongoing projects, and AI image generation powered by leading models. There’s even a Chrome extension to integrate it directly into your browsing workflow.

The Unlimited Plan means unlimited messages per month, making it ideal for startups, product teams, marketers, and prompt engineers who run experiments nonstop. You also get priority support and early access to new features and future models.

Stop paying a separate subscription for AI tools that waste your time.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Use code AUG25 to get lifetime access to ChatPlayground on sale for $59.25. Offer expires Aug. 9 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

StackSocial prices subject to change.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR：ChatPlayground 让您可以终生访问数十种主要 AI 模型，终身只需 59.25 美元（原价 619 美元），使用代码 AUG25。

图片来源：ChatPlayground AI

$59.25
$619 Save $559.75

人工智能具有快速发挥作用的巨大潜力，但也存在大量浪费时间和代价高昂的挫折。 使用多个模型是完成大量工作的好方法，但它要求您在选项卡之间复制Pro pts，并为您使用的每个模型单独支付订阅费用。 如果您想要一种更智能的工作方式，ChatPlayground 是一个新平台，它整合了许多最流行的人工智能工具，因此您可以向所有这些工具发送一个提示。 售价仅为 59.25 美元（原价 619 美元）。

ChatPlayground 让您可以在一个干净的界面中访问 GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Llama、Perplexity 等。 它非常适合那些快速迭代、测试变化并真正关心优化结果的人。

除了比较之外，ChatPlayground AI 还包括用于优化输出的提示工程工具、用于上下文感知响应的图像和 PDF 聊天、为正在进行的项目保存的聊天历史记录以及由领先模型提供支持的 AI 图像生成。 甚至还有一个 Chrome 扩展程序可以将其直接集成到您的浏览工作流程中。

无限制计划意味着每月无限的消息，使其成为初创公司、产品团队、营销人员和不间断运行实验的提示工程师的理想选择。 您还可以获得优先支持并尽早使用新功能和未来型号。

停止为浪费您时间的人工智能工具单独付费。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

使用代码 AUG25 获得 ChatPlayground 的终身使用权，售价 59.25 美元。 优惠截止日期为 8 月 9 日晚上 11:59 PT。

StackSocial 价格可能会发生变化。
